_about: Each bad example and a piece of the problem it must be refused for, checked by the Python and the JavaScript tests with today = 2026-11-17. Good examples are illustrative: versions, dates and the all-zero hashes aren't real. `digests`: the SHA-256 of each good example's canonical JSON, which both languages must compute alike.

bad.address-not-host.json: url: must name a public host
bad.command-climbs-out.json: commands.uv: must be a relative path
bad.released-too-recently.json: released: 2026-11-12 is less than 7 days ago
bad.shell-in-env.json: env.UV_CACHE_DIR: text of at most 300 characters
bad.smoke-not-a-command.json: smoke: must start with one of the tool's commands
bad.strip-on-appimage.json: strip: only for tar and zip
bad.url-too-long.json: url: must be an https URL of at most 150 characters
